description: Links a Sentry user to an external identity provider's user within a Sentry organization; the Sentry user must be an organization member, an active integration for the provider must be configured, and `external_id` is typically required for the external user.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for linking an external provider's user to a Sentry user within an organization.

external_id.description: The user's unique identifier on the external provider's platform (e.g., GitHub user ID, Slack member ID). This ID is specific to the selected `provider`.
external_id.title: External Id

external_name.description: The display name of the user as known on the external provider's platform (e.g., GitHub username, Slack display name).
external_name.title: External Name

id.description: The unique numeric identifier for the external actor linkage being created. Its specific use may depend on the integration or Sentry's internal handling.
id.title: Id

integration_id.description: The numeric ID of the Sentry integration that corresponds to the specified provider and is configured for the organization.
integration_id.title: Integration Id

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry organization where the external user linkage will be created.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

provider.description: The external identity provider. Allowed values: `github`, `github_enterprise`, `slack`, `gitlab`, `msteams`, `custom_scm`.
provider.title: Provider

user_id.description: The numeric ID of the Sentry user to be linked with the external identity.
user_id.title: User Id

inputSchema.title: CreateExternalUserForOrganizationRequest

name: create_external_user_for_organization

CreateExternalUserForOrganizationRespons.description: Response schema for `CreateExternalUserForOrganization`, containing details of the created external user linkage.

externalId.description: The associated user ID for provider.
externalId.title: External Id

externalName.description: The associated name for the provider (e.g., '@Billybob' for GitHub username).
externalName.title: External Name

id.description: The external actor ID (unique identifier for the external user record).
id.title: Id

provider.description: The provider of the external actor (e.g., 'github').
provider.title: Provider

CreateExternalUserForOrganizationRespons.title: CreateExternalUserForOrganizationResponse
